incident.summary: An independent audit used an overbroad local environment inventory and accessed the dormant provider credential despite the OS-13A prohibition on reading it.

containment: Stopped OS-13A before contract freeze or implementation
Interrupted the remaining OS-13A audit tasks
Did not call a provider, use the credential, or repeat its value
Verified the working tree remained unchanged at the accepted OS-03A commit
requiredRemediation: Revoke and regenerate the dormant provider credential in the provider dashboard
Restage the replacement without pasting it into chat or exposing it to the repository
Begin a clean successor OS-13A attempt with environment-secret access explicitly prohibited in every delegated audit
